disposition_reason: The opinion's batch-to-batch table prints mercury, cadmium, arsenic, lead and other metals for five batches of the DHA-rich algal oil intended for infant and follow-on formula; all toxic-metal results are below LOQ except where noted. The Panel concluded the NF is safe under the proposed conditions of use (p. 1, Section 4).

study.design: EFSA NDA Panel novel-food safety opinion; applicant batch-to-batch compositional data (5 independent batches)
study.origin: Applicant's commercial fermentation of Schizochytrium limacinum strain FCC-3204; production site not stated
study.method: Batch analyses by accredited laboratories; metal method not named in Table 1
study.lod_text: LOQs printed in the table cells: tHg 0.005 mg/kg; Cd 0.005 mg/kg; tAs 0.01 mg/kg; Pb 0.01 mg/kg; Cu 0.05 mg/kg; Fe 0.2 mg/kg
study.qa: Panel states the applicant provided information on the accreditation of the laboratories; no CRM or recovery data reported in the opinion
